modifications: Unmodified source T-pose converted from GLB to OBJ for Mixamo automatic rigging; Mixamo humanoid skin imported as FBX; custom painterly lighting and shader-based red-to-navy armor recoloring. The earlier relaxed static OBJ is not used by the final scene.

rig_and_animation.license_scope: Rigging service and animation are provided under applicable Adobe/Mixamo terms; they are not relicensed here as CC BY.
rig_and_animation.unity_import: Humanoid, globalScale 100, calculated normals (100 degree smoothing), loopTime and loopPose; no root motion

limitations: Local presentation study. Humanoid validity, idle skin deformation, stationary root and looping tested. Automatic hair/armor weights have not been validated for combat or extreme poses; no facial rig or production deformation claim. Original author discloses AI-assisted workflow.
